plain_statement: It is false that: The plane of order 3 (13 points, 13 lines). A circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, followed by one last OR gate reading at most two of its wires. If the last gate is true at every incident point-line pair, and false at every input made of at most three points with all the lines missing them and at every input made of at most three lines with all the points off them, then the circuit before the last gate has at least 63 gates.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Every circuit of AND and OR gates for the point-line graph of the projective plane of order 3 has at least 64 gates
